_help: Every story is rewritten in our own Tamil before it is published; English sources are translated in the same pass. 'provider' picks who does it. auto (recommended) uses gemini or anthropic when their key is set, and falls back to translate when neither is — so the site publishes with no key and upgrades itself when you add one. gemini = Google's free tier (key from aistudio.google.com, no card). anthropic = Claude: the best Tamil, but every story costs money. translate = no key and no language model at all, just machine translation; short briefs, plainer Tamil. Set enabled to false to stop rewriting entirely (the site then publishes only your own posts).

gemini._help: Free tier. Alternatives: gemini-3.5-flash-lite and gemini-3.1-flash-lite are faster and lighter on the quota; gemini-3.8-flash is the strongest. Lower concurrency and raise min_interval_seconds if you see rate-limit messages. thinking_level is minimal, low, medium or high — raise it if the Tamil reads poorly, lower it to stretch the free quota.

anthropic._help: Paid. claude-haiku-4-5 is much cheaper with plainer Tamil; claude-sonnet-5 sits in between. effort is low, medium or high.

translate._help: No API key and no language model. English stories are translated into Tamil; Tamil stories are sent through English and back, which returns the same facts in different wording — and costs twice as much of the allowance. Uses MyMemory: 5000 characters a day anonymously, 50000 with an email in 'email' — SET IT, because without it this manages only a story or two a day. max_chars_per_run must be large enough to finish at least one story (a Tamil one costs about twice max_source_chars); the service's own daily allowance is what limits the total.
